title: Pre-Buy Terms Offered to Members on Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
Gallons are booked ahead on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts only inside the programme's booking window, which opens and closes on the month and day the catalogue fixes, and only on programmes that carry pre-buy at all.

**Size of a booking.** The clause formerly stated here — "A booking must reach the programme's minimum gallons and may not exceed the programme's ceiling as a share of the gallons the member took in the previous twelve months, because pre-buy is a commitment to use fuel and not a position in the market." — is carried for the record and is no longer in force as the basis on which the gallons credited on a request are fixed. The current basis governs how many gallons a signed request is credited with.

**Registration and money.** A signed pre-buy booking is registered with the energy desk before the gallons are put to the member's credit, and the money is taken at the booking rather than at delivery. What settles whether the booking may be credited is the record of the request held by the energy desk — its type, its standing, whether the member has signed it, and its reference — read against the request before the gallons go to the member's credit. The member's recollection of having signed does not stand in place of the record.

**Gallons left at expiry.** The clause formerly stated here — "Gallons unused at the programme's expiry date are dealt with as the programme's treatment says, which on some programmes means crediting the member at the lower of the contracted and posted price and on others means rolling them into the following contract year; nothing is ever simply forfeited." — is carried for the record and is no longer in force as the basis on which gallons standing undrawn are dealt with.

**Getting out of a booking.** The clause formerly stated here — "A member who wants out of a booking before the gallons are drawn pays the programme's cancellation charge per gallon cancelled, and where the posted price has risen above the contracted price the cooperative does not pay the member the difference to release them." — is carried for the record and is no longer in force as the basis on which the charge for releasing gallons is arrived at.

## Points of judgement on the window

The window is a pair of dates in the catalogue: a month and day it opens on and a month and day it closes on. A request lodged before the opening day or after the closing day is outside the window. On a programme the catalogue writes as not offering pre-buy, there is no window at all and no booking is taken.

*Hypothetical.* A member on a programme whose window runs from 1 May to 31 August lodges a signed request dated 31 August. That day is the closing day of the window and so falls inside it. A request dated 1 September falls outside.
